traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills that are spaced moderately apart, white to pale cream, becoming more yellowish with age.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are spaced moderately apart, white to pale cream, becoming more yellowish with age.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: Initially conical or bell-shaped, expanding to become broadly convex or almost flat; bright scarlet to red-orange, sometimes fading with age.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: Initially conical or bell-shaped, expanding to become broadly convex or almost flat; bright scarlet to red-orange, sometimes fading with age.

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnexed to almost free.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnexed to almost free.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, often tapering towards the base; similarly colored to the cap or slightly paler, moist but not slimy.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, often tapering towards the base; similarly colored to the cap or slightly paler, moist but not slimy.

traits.label: Dimensions
traits.text: Cap: 2-5 cm in diameter.
traits.raw: 📐 Cap: 2-5 cm in diameter.

traits.label: Fruit body

traits.label: Spore print

traits.raw: ⚪ Spore Print: White.

traits.label: Description
traits.text: Saprobic, found in grasslands, meadows, and other grassy areas, often after rains.
traits.raw: ☘️🪵 Saprobic, found in grasslands, meadows, and other grassy areas, often after rains.

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Edible, but not particularly sought after due to its small size and rarity.
traits.raw: 🍴 Edible, but not particularly sought after due to its small size and rarity.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores 7-10 x 4-5 µm, ellipsoid, hyaline, smooth.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores 7-10 x 4-5 µm, ellipsoid, hyaline, smooth.

traits.label: Odour

traits.raw: 👃 Not particularly distinctive, sometimes faintly sweet or fragrant.

traits.text: Striking mushroom due to its vibrant red-orange coloration. This mushroom often appears in grassy areas, especially after rains, catching the eye with its radiant hue.

👇 ...
🆔 Hygrocybe coccinea (Schaeff.) P.Kumm.

🇺🇸 Scarlet Hood

🇪🇪 Veri-vesinutt
🇷🇺 Гигроцибе красная

🗓️ 25/Aug/23, 8:20 AM
🌎 Japanese garden, Kadriorg, Tallinn
🛣️☘️ In grassland and moss, with morning dew, urban park
🍄 Hygrophoraceae / Agaricomycetes

ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills that are spaced moderately apart, white to pale cream, becoming more yellowish with age.
ℹ️ Cap: Initially conical or bell-shaped, expanding to become broadly convex or almost flat; bright scarlet to red-orange, sometimes fading with age.
ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnexed to almost free.
ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, often tapering towards the base; similarly colored to the cap or slightly paler, moist but not slimy.
📐 Cap: 2-5 cm in diameter.
📏 Fruit body: 3-8 cm tall.
⚪ Spore Print: White.
☘️🪵 Saprobic, found in grasslands, meadows, and other grassy areas, often after rains.
🍴 Edible, but not particularly sought after due to its small size and rarity.
🔬 Spores 7-10 x 4-5 µm, ellipsoid, hyaline, smooth.
👃 Not particularly distinctive, sometimes faintly sweet or fragrant.
🔤 Striking mushroom due to its vibrant red-orange coloration. This mushroom often appears in grassy areas, especially after rains, catching the eye with its radiant hue.
